_meta.title: Independent official-source verification log
_meta.method: Each claim the user raised was re-checked against the live official NFL.com page (injury report, game centres, NFL.com news) by direct fetch on 2026-11-16. Only values read from those pages are recorded. Where a value could not be confirmed, it is left blank and the claim is marked NOT VERIFIED rather than inferred.

status_legend.CONFIRMED: The claim matches the official source exactly.
status_legend.PARTIALLY CONFIRMED: The official source supports part of the claim; the remainder is unverified or differs.
status_legend.REFUTED: The official source contradicts the claim as stated.
status_legend.RECONCILED: The claim's numbers differ from an independent recount; the qualitative point is settled and the numeric gap is published.

claims.claim: Kerby Joseph, Cade Mays and D.J. Reed are published with a blank game-status cell while the official article lists all three as Out.
claims.finding: On the official Week 10 injury report, all three Detroit Lions are listed with Game Status = Out: Kerby Joseph (S, Knee, Did Not Participate), Cade Mays (C, Ankle, Did Not Participate), D.J. Reed (CB, Hip, Did Not Participate). The 'blank game-status' description does not match the live official page; the Out designations are published.
claims.source_title: Official NFL Injury Report - Week 10 (Detroit Lions section)
claims.note: Resolves R062. The three Out statuses are now verified against the official source.

claims.claim: Seattle is shown as injury-free while listing 15 players.
claims.finding: The official Week 10 injury report lists 15 Seattle Seahawks rows (AJ Barner, Anthony Bradford, Charles Cross, Sam Darnold, Derick Hall, Drew Lock, Quenton Nelson, Uchenna Nwosu, Patrick O'Connell, Connor O'Toole, Brandon Pili, Jarran Reed, Rashid Shaheed, Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Leonard Williams). Seattle is not injury-free.
claims.source_title: Official NFL Injury Report - Week 10 (Seattle Seahawks section)
claims.note: Resolves the Seattle half of R061. The '15 players' count matches.

claims.claim: Cincinnati is shown as injury-free while listing 4 players.
claims.finding: The official Week 10 injury report lists 9 Cincinnati Bengals rows in total, of which exactly 4 carry a game-status designation: Kyle Dugger (Out), Jalen Davis (Doubtful), Andrei Iosivas (Doubtful), Brian Parker II (Doubtful). Cincinnati is not injury-free. The '4 players' matches the count of designated players, not the total rows.
claims.source_title: Official NFL Injury Report - Week 10 (Cincinnati Bengals section)
claims.note: Resolves the Cincinnati half of R061 with a clarification: 4 designated players out of 9 total rows.

claims.claim: Published counts are stale: 254 rows and 4 no-injury sections versus 279 rows and 2 sections live.
claims.finding: An independent recount of the live official Week 10 injury report on 2026-11-16 yields 347 player rows across 28 teams (per-team counts published on the Verification page). The repository's checked-in capture holds 345 rows and the claim's 279 rows is not reproduced. The row-count conflict is real but the live total is materially higher than both cited numbers.
claims.source_title: Official NFL Injury Report - Week 10 (full page)
claims.note: Reconciled. The qualitative point (published counts are stale and teams are not injury-free) is settled. The exact live total should be re-derived programmatically in CI to remove manual-recount error.

claims.claim: The NFL publishes a dated starter change for Drew Lock.
claims.finding: NFL.com news (Week 10, Friday) reports Drew Lock has no injury designation and will start for the Seahawks against the Raiders, per coach Mike Macdonald. Lock was limited in practice with right elbow and oblique injuries.
claims.source_title: Drew Lock (elbow/oblique) has no injury designation, will start for Seahawks vs. Raiders - NFL.com
claims.note: Resolves the Lock half of R066 with a dated official source.

claims.claim: The NFL publishes a dated starter change for Kyle McCord.
claims.finding: NFL.com news reports the Dolphins placed QB Malik Willis (groin) on injured reserve on Tuesday and that Kyle McCord will make his first NFL start, on the road against the Colts in Week 10.
claims.source_title: Dolphins place QB Malik Willis (groin) on injured reserve; Kyle McCord in line for first start - NFL.com
claims.note: Resolves the McCord half of R066 with a dated official source.

claims.claim: The NFL publishes a dated starter change for Brissett.
claims.finding: No dated official starter-change article for Brissett was fetched in this pass. The Ravens' Week 10 injury-report section lists no quarterbacks, and Lamar Jackson is confirmed on injured reserve (see V-BAL). The Brissett starter designation remains unverified here.
claims.note: Left blank and flagged. Do not publish a Brissett starter value without a dated official source.

claims.claim: Baltimore still publishes Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley at QB after both went on injured reserve and a replacement was traded in.
claims.finding: The official Week 10 injury report's Baltimore Ravens section lists no quarterbacks at all: Lamar Jackson is absent (consistent with his confirmed injured-reserve placement) and Tyler Huntley is absent. This confirms the report omits IR'd quarterbacks. The 'stale depth row' claim concerns club depth-chart pages, which were not re-fetched in this pass.
claims.source_title: Official NFL Injury Report - Week 10 (Baltimore Ravens section)
claims.note: Supports the report-omits-IR-QBs finding (F02/FLG-005). The club depth-chart staleness itself remains to be re-verified against the club page.

claims.claim: Transcribe the venue of every fixture from the official game centre and publish it.
claims.finding: All 14 Week 10 fixtures were transcribed from their official NFL.com game-centre pages. Location and Stadium for each fixture are published on the Venues page with the per-game source link.
claims.source_title: NFL Week 10 schedule (hub) and per-fixture game centres
claims.note: Resolves R024 for the Week 10 window.

claims.claim: Use official NFL Game Books for actual starters and game-day status.
claims.finding: Every official NFL.com game-centre page publishes a 'Download Game Book (PDF)' link under 'END GAME'. The Game Book PDF URL for each of the 12 final Week 10 games is published on the Game Books page. This establishes a verified official route for actual starters and game-day status.
claims.source_title: Official NFL game centre (Game Book PDF route)
claims.note: Resolves the source-route half of R026. Game Book contents (starters/inactives) are not yet parsed; only the route is verified.

claims.claim: Publish the league's dated schedule announcement beside the live schedule page.
claims.finding: The official NFL media release '2026 NFL Schedule Announced' is dated May 14, 2026 and announces the 18-week, 272-game 2026 regular-season schedule. The live schedule hub is the per-week schedule page. Both are published on the Sources page.
claims.note: Resolves R025. The dated announcement and the live schedule are now both linked.

claims.claim: Publish a weekly 'what changed' diff instead of a static snapshot.
claims.finding: The repository's standings snapshot is dated 2026-11-14 (pre-Week-10-completion). The live official standings on 2026-11-16 now reflect completed Week 10 results (e.g. BUF and SF both 8-1; DET 7-2; CHI 7-2). The checked-in standings are therefore one week stale relative to the live source. This is published as a staleness finding rather than silently overwritten.
claims.note: Surfaces a real weekly change. A full re-ingestion of standings is a separate task; this log records the delta and the source.

claims.claim: No Baltimore Ravens quarterback appears on the Week 10 injury report despite Lamar Jackson being ruled out 6–10 weeks.
claims.finding: Re-checked 2026-11-18 against the official Week 10 injury report: the Baltimore Ravens section contains 10 player rows and zero quarterbacks (Rasheen Ali, Rashod Bateman, Calais Campbell [DNP, blank game status], Kyle Hamilton, Jaylinn Hawkins [Knee, Out], Matthew Hibner, Olaivavega Ioane, Adam Randall [Questionable], Ronnie Stanley [DNP, blank game status], Nate Wiggins). Lamar Jackson is absent from the report, consistent with his confirmed injured-reserve placement; Calais Campbell and Ronnie Stanley appear with blank game status. The injury table alone does not reveal every starter change.
claims.source_title: Official NFL Injury Report - Week 10 (Baltimore Ravens section)

claims.claim: The live Week 10 injury report lists players under clubs they are not on, including Kyler Murray under Minnesota, Micah Parsons under Green Bay, J.J. McCarthy under the N.Y. Giants, and Kyle Dugger and Dexter Lawrence under Cincinnati.
claims.finding: Re-checked 2026-11-18 against the official Week 10 injury report: Kyler Murray (QB, Hamstring, Out) appears in the Minnesota section; Micah Parsons (LB, Knee/Illness, Out) appears in the Green Bay section; J.J. McCarthy (QB) appears in the N.Y. Giants section; Kyle Dugger (S, Quadricep, Out) and Dexter Lawrence (DT) appear in the Cincinnati section. These are how the official page publishes them; they are recorded as published, not corrected (flag F03).
claims.source_title: Official NFL Injury Report - Week 10 (multiple club sections)
claims.note: Confirms F03 roster-affiliation anomalies observed on the live official page. Independent re-capture 2026-11-18.
